stemMd: A rectangular plot is 20 m east-west and 12 m north-south. On a diagram at 1:200, a north-south path of real width 2 m crosses the full plot. What is the path’s printed area?
explanationMd: At1:200, the path is1 cm wide and6 cm long. Its printed area is1×6=6 cm². Scaling both dimensions is essential; the full plot would measure10 by6 cm.

distractorRationale.d: The path’s printed width is1 cm, not2 cm.
distractorRationale.c: This is the real area in square metres, not the printed area.
distractorRationale.e: This applies an additional halving after both dimensions are scaled.
distractorRationale.a: This exceeds the entire plot’s printed area.
